scope: All 32 v2 samples for each finalist; including structurally invalid outputs with readable descriptions
limitations: Non-blind assistant-authored semantic and readability annotations, informed by development failures. Not independent human evaluation or model-scored judgement. Uncertain cases are not passes. Review considers supplied facts, outcomes and world contract; exact quotations support issues. Annotations may be revised after developer review. The existing run scores and pending human forms are unchanged.

records.description: The beacon is now perfectly aligned, glowing steadily. The alignment control clicks into place, confirming the adjustment. The shelter bench remains untouched, offering a place to rest. The signalling console is ready, awaiting your command to send out a rescue signal. The library key jingles in your pocket, a reminder of the entrance you left. The storm outside rages on, but inside, the generator hums quietly, its power restored. The telescope chamber, once a place of observation, now stands as a beacon of hope, its light piercing through the storm. No rescue signal has been sent yet, and no ending has been chosen. The mountain path remains unsafe, but here, you are safe. The fuse is installed, ensuring the generator's life force. The daylight, though diffuse, illuminates the room without the need for electrical power. The beacon's alignment is the first step towards a rescue, but the journey is not yet complete.
